h1: Live Music for Your Campus Event

intro: Conor books live sets for fraternity and sorority formals, socials, welcome week, tailgates, and general campus programming — solo vocals and acoustic guitar across Pop, R&B, Country, Hip‑Hop, and the songs your chapter already knows every word to. Available for campuses within about 100 miles of Pittsburgh.

sections.heading: Formals, Socials & Campus Programming
sections.body: Greek life formals and socials, welcome week, tailgates, homecoming, philanthropy events, campus activities board bookings — a solo acoustic act sets up fast, needs minimal space, and reads the room without a full band's logistics.

sections.heading: Covers Your Crowd Actually Knows, Plus Originals
sections.body: The set draws from Pop, R&B, Country, Hip‑Hop, and the classics alongside Conor's own released music — built for a crowd that wants to sing along, not sit through a set list they don't recognize.

sections.heading: Campuses in Range
sections.body: Home base is Pittsburgh, with bookings typically staying within about 100 miles — covering campuses across the Pittsburgh area, Washington County, out to Morgantown, West Virginia, and beyond. That's a service-area radius, not a list of past shows — reach out to check your campus.

faqs.q: What kinds of college events does Conor play?
faqs.a: Fraternity and sorority formals and socials, welcome week, tailgates, homecoming, philanthropy events, and campus activities board bookings.

faqs.q: Does he play originals or just covers?
faqs.a: Both — his own released music alongside a wide covers range across Pop, R&B, Country, Hip-Hop, and the classics.

faqs.q: What's the service area for campus bookings?
faqs.a: Roughly 100 miles of Pittsburgh — reach out with your campus and date and he'll confirm.

faqs.q: How does a chapter or campus org book him?
faqs.a: Use the form on this page or email conorpedersonmusic@gmail.com with your event date, location, and organization name.
